description: This is a header file defining the WifiManager class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares the class's inheritance, methods, events, interface mappings, and internal components related to WiFi management, including scanning, connection, WPS, signal threshold, and state handling.

classes.name: WifiManager
classes.description: Main class managing WiFi operations, implementing interfaces for plugin and JSONRPC communication, and handling WiFi states, scans, connections, and events.

methods.name: WifiManager
methods.description: Constructor for WifiManager class.

methods.name: ~WifiManager
methods.description: Destructor for WifiManager class.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi quirks/configurations based on parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Fetches the current WiFi state.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi network scan.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables WiFi.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Triggers secondary WPS pairing process.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID for future connections.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Clears saved SSIDs.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the paired network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed info about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if a device is paired.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Retrieves supported WiFi security modes.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for WiFi state changes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Event handler for error occurrences.

methods.name: onSSIDsChanged
methods.description: Event handler when list of SSIDs changes.

methods.name: onWifiSignalThresholdChanged
methods.description: Event handler for signal strength threshold changes.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Event triggered when available SSIDs are updated.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to WifiManager instance.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the API version number.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the API version number.
